descriptionMarkdown:
My first legendary ship

Will produces

- Legendary Iron Plate
- Legendary Copper Plate
- Legendary Coal
- Legendary Carbon
- Legendary Sulfur
- Legendary Ice
- Legendary Calcite

Features

- Top speed 200 km/s
- Fuel control, make sure fuel consumption is at 40-50%
- Large cargo bay for asteroid, can hold up to 6k each asteroid type
- Self-sustained, can produce enough fuel and ammunition to continue exploring without needing to orbit to refuel. **but still need a continuous supply with fusion power cell**
- Have 6 lines of asteroid reprocessing. All controls with circuits to ensure the belt does not jam.

Notes
- For starters, you can use non-legendary parts
title: My First Legendary Ship
